steps.text: 万神院里的神。没解锁的写着？？？？，声望到了那个节点才开。

texts.en: The gods of the Senatus Panthei. Locked ones show ????; they open once your Standing reaches their milestone.

steps.text: 不想奉神就选无信者，升级只出通用牌。

texts.en: Choose Faithless to follow no god; level-ups then offer only general cards.

steps.text: 点【奉祂】定下这一局奉谁。祂的信物出征时自动放进背包，局后不带回仓库。

texts.en: Click Follow to choose this run's god. The god's Charm goes into your bag when you set out, and does not come back to the storeroom.
